description: This file implements Linux process event monitoring using netlink sockets, defining event types, message structures, and a monitor function to receive process events such as fork, exec, exit, and communication events.

classes.name: ProcEvent
classes.description: Represents a generic process event with header and message.

classes.name: ProcEventHeader
classes.description: Contains metadata about the process event such as type, CPU, and timestamp.

classes.name: ExitProcEvent
classes.description: Represents a process exit event with process and parent info, exit code, and signal.

classes.name: ExecProcEvent
classes.description: Represents a process exec event with process ID and TID.

classes.name: ForkProcEvent
classes.description: Represents a process fork event with parent and child process IDs and TIDs.

classes.name: CommProcEvent
classes.description: Represents a process communication event with process ID, TID, and command name.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Sets the header fields of a ProcEvent from a ProcEventHeader.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with the event.

methods.name: Tgid
methods.description: Returns the thread group ID associated with the event.

methods.name: ProcEventMonitor
methods.description: Sets up a netlink socket to monitor process events and sends parsed events through a channel.

methods.name: parseNetlinkMessage
methods.description: Parses a netlink message into a specific ProcEvent type based on the event header.
